maria: Quick all-hands follow-up: leadership asked for the RCA link and clear owners for the reliability action items from last week's incident. Posting the link + proposed owners here. Please ack or update.

Dante: RCA link: https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf. Good write-up. Noting customer impact summary for exec slide: ~6% 5xx spike for ~45m, no data loss.

anika: Proposed owners look good. I'll own adding autoscaler rollback + verification into roadmap and create PD-4823 with ACs. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ryan: I'll take the controlled canary stress test and add a KV-cache-thrash alert to monitoring. Plan to run tests today and post graphs in #eng-sre. Owner: ryan.

leah: I'll finalize customer comms and coordinate with AMs. Draft link (internal): https://docs.google.com/draft-example. Aiming to send Monday morning.

devops-bot: Incident 2024-04-24 RCA uploaded: https://redwood-infra.internal/rcas/2024-04-24-nvme-autoscaler.pdf (automated).

maria: Action items recap (from all-hands): 1) sam - 1-page RCA summary + checklist -> incidents (sam). 2) ryan - canary scale test + monitoring alert (ryan). 3) anika - roadmap ticket for rollback/verification (anika). 4) leah - customer comms + AM coordination (leah). Please confirm ETAs in-thread.

Dante: For the slide deck, send me a 1-line exec summary by EOD so I can prep slides.

ryan: Confirmed. I'll post test results and a short blurb by 18:00 UTC.

anika: Confirmed. PD-4823 created and linked to roadmap.

leah: Confirmed. Will share final comms draft by EOD.

maria: Thanks team. We'll review in the SRE sync on Thursday. If anyone hits blockers, post in #eng-oncall or ping me. Closing this follow-up thread.
